WITH DynastyArtifactCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artdynasty AS Dynasty,
        SUM(t4.conservepriorityscore) AS TotalPriorityScore,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t3.budgetallocstatus ILIKE 'Adequate' THEN 1 END) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t3.budgetallocstatus ILIKE 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(t2.conservediff) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        artifactratings AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance AS t3 ON t1.artregistry = t3.artrefmaintained
    JOIN 
        riskassessments AS t4 ON t1.artregistry = t4.artrefconcerned
    GROUP BY 
        t1.artdynasty
),
BudgetStatus AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artdynasty AS Dynasty,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM artifactscore AS t5
                JOIN artifactratings AS t6 ON t5.artregistry = t6.artref
                JOIN conservationandmaintenance AS t7 ON t5.artregistry = t7.artrefmaintained
                WHERE 
                    t5.artdynasty = t1.artdynasty
                    AND t6.conservediff < 0.5
                    AND t7.budgetallocstatus ILIKE 'Insufficient'
                    AND t6.conservestatus ILIKE 'Critical'
            ) THEN 'Budget Crisis'
            ELSE 'Within Budget'
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        artifactratings AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance AS t3 ON t1.artregistry = t3.artrefmaintained
    JOIN 
        riskassessments AS t4 ON t1.artregistry = t4.artrefconcerned
    GROUP BY 
        t1.artdynasty
)
SELECT 
    DAC.Dynasty,
    DAC.TotalPriorityScore,
    DAC.AdequateFundingCount,
    DAC.InsufficientFundingCount,
    DAC.BudgetEfficiencyValue,
    BS.BudgetStatus
FROM 
    DynastyArtifactCounts AS DAC
JOIN 
    BudgetStatus AS BS ON DAC.Dynasty = BS.Dynasty
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'ALL DYNASTIES',
    SUM(DAC.TotalPriorityScore),
    SUM(DAC.AdequateFundingCount),
    SUM(DAC.InsufficientFundingCount),
    AVG(DAC.BudgetEfficiencyValue),
    MAX(CASE WHEN BS.BudgetStatus = 'Budget Crisis' THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END)
FROM 
    DynastyArtifactCounts AS DAC
JOIN 
    BudgetStatus AS BS ON DAC.Dynasty = BS.Dynasty;
